title: PeTRA — Open Documentation
description: Open Documentation for PeTRA, an analytics engine for serious games. Methodology, design rationale, and architecture for researchers building their own implementations. PeTRA is a worked example of praxichnology, the methodological framework for reading traces produced through situated activity in designed environments (Loh, 2026; preprint https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20148907).
